Criteria for Approval:
• Diagnosis of nausea and/or vomiting (N/V) associated with cancer chemotherapy; AND
○ Trial and failure of ≥ 1 non-cannabinoid antiemetic (e.g. ondansetron); OR
• Diagnosis of anorexia associated with weight loss in a patient with acquired immune deficiency syndrome (AIDS) or cancer.

Quantity Limit: 2 per day

• Patient is a pregnant female; AND
• Diagnosis of nausea and vomiting of pregnancy.

Quantity Limit: 4 per day
